preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly 6 lines: n, s, e; x; a; b; c; d.
All input lines are non-empty and contain only integers.

preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= e <= n and s != e
preconditions.description: n is the number of chairs (2 ≤ n ≤ 5000), s and e are distinct chair indices (1 ≤ s, e ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and len(a) == n and len(b) == n and len(c) == n and len(d) == n
preconditions.description: x, a, b, c, and d are lists of length n, where x is strictly increasing (x1 < x2 < ... < xn).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 for xi in x) and all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a) and all(1 <= bi <= 10**9 for bi in b) and all(1 <= ci <= 10**9 for ci in c) and all(1 <= di <= 10**9 for di in d)
preconditions.description: All values in x, a, b, c, and d are positive integers (1 ≤ value ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.description: Output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total time.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1)) and all(1 <= j <= n for j in range(1, n + 1)) and s != e
postconditions.description: The problem constraints (n, s, e, x, a, b, c, d) are respected in the computation.

postconditions.expression: any(all(i in permutation for i in range(1, n + 1)) and permutation[0] == s and permutation[-1] == e for permutation in permutations(range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The solution considers all possible permutations of chairs starting at s and ending at e, visiting each chair exactly once.

postconditions.expression: lambda permutation: sum((abs(x[permutation[i] - 1] - x[permutation[i + 1] - 1]) + (c[permutation[i] - 1] if permutation[i + 1] < permutation[i] else d[permutation[i] - 1]) + (b[permutation[i + 1] - 1] if permutation[i + 1] < permutation[i] else a[permutation[i + 1] - 1])) for i in range(len(permutation) - 1))
postconditions.description: For each permutation, the total time is computed as the sum of jump times between consecutive chairs, where jump time from i to j is |xi - xj| + ci + bj if j < i, or |xi - xj| + di + aj if j > i.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == min(sum((abs(x[permutation[i] - 1] - x[permutation[i + 1] - 1]) + (c[permutation[i] - 1] if permutation[i + 1] < permutation[i] else d[permutation[i] - 1]) + (b[permutation[i + 1] - 1] if permutation[i + 1] < permutation[i] else a[permutation[i + 1] - 1])) for i in range(len(permutation) - 1)) for permutation in permutations(range(1, n + 1)) if permutation[0] == s and permutation[-1] == e)
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum total time across all valid permutations.
